# Phase 13 — the original request, verbatim

**The source of asks #11 and #12 in `11-roadmap.md`'s ACCEPTANCE LEDGER.** Filed 2026-09-15, at the
moment it was made, which is the whole point: `D214` exists because the Phase-12 request lived in a
chat that was cleared and five of its ten asks went missing with nothing able to notice.

**Do not edit, summarise, or "tidy" this file.** It is evidence. The ledger rows are a *reading* of
this text, and a reading can drift from its source — when the wording of an ask is argued over, this
is the thing to argue from.

**Context it was given in:** the maintainer's stated use of this tool is *set a goal, let the
orchestrator drive it across many sessions, oversee*. Both asks come out of living in that loop, not
from a design review. His closing line — *"thats it after these 2 points and the earlier goals are
finished ill update every repo i use this plugin on"* — makes this batch the gate on a real rollout.
